name: DevOps & Infrastructure as Code
description: Orchestration profile for IaC, containers, and CI/CD with offline syntax checks and protective boundaries for live configs and credentials.

tools.name: terraform
tools.description: Tool for formatting and validity checks of Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

tools.name: docker
tools.description: Tool for packaging and validating container configurations.

tools.name: kubectl
tools.description: CLI for validating Kubernetes manifests (dry-run/client mode).

candidate_checks.description: Validate Terraform configuration offline without connecting to cloud state.
Validate JSON configuration, profiles, templates, and Markdown links of the harness (does not check CI syntax of the consumer repository).

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of repository-accepted offline IaC/CI verification commands
Evidence that credentials, endpoints, live configs, and safety gates were not touched
Evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Inadvertently invoking commands that mutate live environments (terraform apply, kubectl apply, docker push)
Exposing secrets/credentials or granting overly permissive IAM policies
Modifying live endpoints or disabling security verification steps in CI/CD
quant_escalation_required_when: Modifying infrastructure configuration that affects risk, margin, or leverage parameters or quantitative execution pipelines
